need.question: {"definition":"Implement reusable protocol finite_bayes_diagnosis/1 in the operator-prepared Python environment using pgmpy 1.1.2 public DiscreteBayesianNetwork, TabularCPD and VariableElimination.query APIs. For parameters p,a1,a0,h1,h0 construct exactly the graph Fault->Alarm and Fault->HeartbeatLost. Set every variable's state_names to [0,1]. Build Fault CPD rows [[1-p],[p]]. Build Alarm CPD rows [[1-a0,1-a1],[a0,a1]] with evidence=['Fault'], evidence_card=[2] and explicit state_names for Alarm and Fault. Build HeartbeatLost CPD rows [[1-h0,1-h1],[h0,h1]] with the same parent order and explicit state_names. Add all CPDs and require check_model() to succeed. Instantiate VariableElimination. Obtain the unconditional joint sensor factor using query(variables=['Alarm','HeartbeatLost'], joint=True, show_progress=False) without conditioning evidence. Read its selected joint entry using get_value(Alarm=int(alarm), HeartbeatLost=int(heartbeat_lost)). Reject zero or nonfinite evidence mass before conditional inference. Obtain the Fault posterior using query(variables=['Fault'], evidence={'Alarm':int(alarm),'HeartbeatLost':int(heartbeat_lost)}, joint=True, show_progress=False). Read Fault=0 and Fault=1 by explicit state names. Require both entries finite and within [0,1] and their sum within absolute tolerance 1e-12 of one. Return Fault=1 as posterior_fault and the selected unconditional joint entry as evidence_normalizer. Set calculation_complete=true only after all fixed finite library computations and validations finish. Never implement the collected quantities using a handwritten Bayes formula or reference constants. Before coding, freeze independent model-derived expectations for the qualification cases described in input_conditions. Actual qualification must inspect generated source, state and parameter correspondence, normalizer handling, actual public API calls and frozen execution results. The native adapter supplies actual UTC query time and provenance outside the three-field logical result, preserving opaque external request identity/context and JSON precision. This logical blueprint selects no provider or execution authority. After ALL raw pgmpy validations, canonicalize BOTH successful probability outputs uniformly as float(format(raw_value, '.15g')): 15 significant decimal digits, never decimal places. Recheck canonical values as finite probabilities, posterior in [0,1] and normalizer in (0,1]; unexpected nonfinite, out-of-range or zero canonical mass is an acquisition error. Set completion only after these checks. This parameter-independent representation preserves tiny positive scales. No answer-specific branch, fixture detection, reference substitution, handwritten Bayes replacement or fixed-place rounding is allowed. The declared-case 1e-12 reference bound remains; arbitrary near-0.75 decision stability and ill-conditioned-input accuracy are not established.","input_conditions":["Accept exactly the declared object shape and required keys with no extras. Permit no data fitting, stochastic sampling, network access, installation, shell invocation, arbitrary graph execution or Torch dependency.","Freeze expectations before implementation. For p=1/50,a1=19/20,a0=1/20,h1=4/5,h0=1/10 and both flags true, expect posterior 152/201 and mass 201/10000 with completion true. This is a measured-negative threshold case rather than an acquisition error.","Freeze a genuinely different valid case with p=1/2,a1=4/5,a0=1/5,h1=3/5,h0=2/5 and both flags true.
